name: Ultand
personality: Kind, motherly cleric who treats Cai like a younger brother.
story: A priestess of the Aurora Temple in upper Dagsion who looks after Cai. She joins automatically on Cai's route from Chapter 6; on other routes she needs renown and the quest 'Her Mother's Gift'. Cai's goals later include saving her, placing her near the central conflict (details unconfirmed).

personalSkill.name: Patch Up
personalSkill.effect: After an adjacent ally's combat, restores a little HP to that ally. Lv 20: Pray for Safety (adjacent allies Ddg +10, crit avoid). Lv 35: Pray for Safety+ (Ddg +20).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: B tier. Pocket Tactics: A tier. Reddit: Guardian 'merely okay', thin white list; Troubadour or Ovate suggested (single report).

why: Joins Cai's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

build.role: Support caster: Black Magic plus adjacency healing
build.notes: Diviner on joining in Ch 6 (trains White and Black Magic, Mag 55), Shaman at Lv 20 (Black Magic C) as the Ch 7 and 8 caster, Ovate at Lv 35 (Black Magic B), likely Ch 10 after her Ch 9 absence. Patch Up and Pray for Safety pair her with Noctula. Part II Ch 4 to 5: Bishop for Barrier. Part III: Druid. Changed from Soldier, Priest, Guardian: Ch 6 to 9 had three healers and no second caster.

guide.role: Support caster: Black Magic plus adjacency healing
guide.summary: The Hard video rates Ultand A/B and names Ovate as a good class for her (its first pick, Blacksmith, rates C and may be Dietrich-only). She has no Physic, so as a Guardian she was a third, weaker healer. As Diviner, Shaman and Ovate she is the second caster Ch 6 to 9 lacked, and Patch Up and Pray for Safety still heal and protect whoever stands next to her. Ovate grows Mag 60, Dex 55, Res 60 on her.
guide.playstyle: Cast from 2 tiles on player phase, then end beside Noctula or the unit taking hits: Patch Up heals it after each fight and Pray for Safety adds Ddg +10 (+20 at Lv 35). Heal and Seraphim only in emergencies.
keys: Make her a Diviner on joining, not a Soldier: she needs Black Magic C by Lv 20 and it is not a preferred rank.
Shaman at Lv 20 (Ch 7): doubled Black Magic makes her the Ch 7 and Ch 8 nuker and trains Black Magic B for Ovate.
Pair her with Noctula: Pray for Safety and Patch Up on the dodge tank, Ninae on Noctula's other side against mages.
Ovate at Lv 35 and Renown 8, likely Ch 10 after her Ch 9 absence; Sirocco takes the main nuke role once he joins (late Ch 10 or Ch 11).
Part II Ch 4 to 5: a Bishop stint for Barrier, a third aura next to Patch Up and Pray for Safety+.
watch: Out for Ch 9: her Ovate exam likely slips to Ch 10.
Def growth 25% in Shaman and Ovate: she stands beside the front line, never in it.
No Physic in her spell list: Tialla and Ninae carry it.
Black Magic is not a preferred rank: if it lags, stay Diviner until it reaches C.

Heavy dark spells: Banshee Θ 23 + Magic Staff 3 = 26 and Dark Spikes Τ 20 + 3 = 23, against Bolganone 8 + 3 = 11. With Spd growth 35, any counter doubles her: cast Banshee from range 3 and Dark Spikes at range 2 on melee cavalry. Hit is 50 / 60 before Dex and Ovate's Magic Hit +5: check the forecast.
Inventory: 3 core (Wooden Gauntlets, Magic Staff, Concoction); spells don't use slots.

guide.summary: She stands next to the Fortress walls (Theodora, Ninae, Tobias) and keeps them up: Patch Up heals every adjacent ally after each of its combats, and Pray for Safety+ gives them Ddg +20. End every turn touching as many walls as you can. Cha 50 makes her the best battalion carrier after Theodora.
guide.playstyle: Enemy phase: sit diagonal-behind the wall so the walls take the hits and she patches them after each one. Player phase: Heal (range 1) the worst wall, then move to touch two or three of them. Seraphim on undead.
